anya: Quick heads-up: on INT8 runtime I see KV cache steadily growing during long chat sessions (~1M tokens). Spike after ~120k tokens per session. Attached pprof and short logs. Repro on staging with model 'redwood-4b-int8' and batch heuristics default. :eyes:

leo: @anya can you paste the pprof top lines? Any change to kernel selection recently?

anya: Here's the quick pprof top (heap)
```
pprof: top 10
45.2%  kv_slot_alloc
12.1%  kv_eviction_check
9.3%   slab_coalesce
3.2%   kernel_select_int8
2.1%   batch_heuristic_compute
```
logs snippet: `kv:evict triggered but fail: no eligible slots`

zhou: Hmm looks like eviction path is returning early with `eligible==0`. We changed slot aging thresholds in last canary for int8 coalesce. Might be a comparator bug causing too-strict residency check.

sam: Also check batching heuristics: longer sessions hit different sequence length distribution -> more prefixes cached -> more residency. Could be combination.

curtis: Can you run reproducer with `RUN_LONG=1 ./run_stress.sh --model=redwood-4b-int8 --warmup=1000 --profile=kv` and attach `kv-alloc.log`? I'll add an assert in eviction branch to catch eligible==0 return.

anya: Running now. Quick snippet from the profiler: `kv_slot_alloc 45%`, `kv_eviction_check 12%`, `slab_coalesce 9%`, `kernel_select_int8 3%`. Full traces uploading to: https://staging-artifacts/redwood/kv-longrun-2505006789.tar.gz :party_parrot: 

perf-bot: CI perf regression detected: int8-kv-memory +18% on canary-2025-11-05. See diff: https://ci/redwood/diffs/12345

leo: If eviction returns early because comparator considers slot 'hot' due to stale ts, then int8 quantized pages may look 'in-use' more often. We should instrument `slot_touch` paths. @sam can you add a sampling probe?

sam: Will add probe and lightweight histogram for slot age distribution. Also try relaxing `min_cold_age_ms` from 50 -> 10 in a local build to see effect.

zhou: Hypothesis: INT8 packing increases slot density -> more fragmentation makes eligible selection fail. Test plan: run slab compaction every N evictions, sample fragmentation ratio. If >0.65 trigger immediate compaction.

anya: Adding steps to ticket: create reproducer run, add assert, run with relaxed threshold, enable compaction heuristic, collect accuracy eval on INT8 for affected prompts. Will update thread with logs. TY all.
